name: bitbox-mk2-semi
features: Fidelity
Interp list Normal, HighQ, SP1200, SP-12, S950, MPC60, SP Raw, 16k..2k on Sample, Clip, Slicer, Granular (Conf)
24 dB filter, Drive, Filter 2
State-variable filter instead of the pad biquad; tanh drive and a second 24 dB filter (LFO page)
Clip tools
Shift, Play Len, Stretch % with Str Mode Auto / Jump / Smooth (pitch kept), Loop Fade, Sync 1/32
Slicer sync
Sync Grid (1 bar .. 1/32) and Slice Str Cut / Stretch / Tape: slices fill their synced duration
Delay and reverb
Delay types Digital / Tape / BBD, reverb types Plate / Room / Hall / Chamber, each with a second page
FX3 and FX Out
Third send (touch the selected FX2 cell again); FX returns to Out1/2 or the FX1/2 jacks
Master section
Compressor Stock / SSL with Mix and bus choice, master distortion Soft / Hard / Fold / Tube
Modulation
MOD sources KEY (keyboard tracking) and ENV (the pad's ADSR); CV In scale / offset; CV pitch quantizer
GEN sequencer
4 lanes on the MK2 clock: Euclid, Breakcut, Call+Resp, Evolve, Drummap, Random; step conditions; Epoch
UI
Double tap a dial for its default; vertical waveform zoom (two fingers); screen saver with a live scope
Fixes and status
Clip / Slicer Poly Mode Mono honoured; CPU load in the status bar
title: 2.3.4-sK: everything
summary: All patch sets; the combination the tests cover.
